thread:
joria_partners: Quick thread  Partner ask: they want a single-entry quickstart that creates a tiny "runtime" (network, storage, runtime) via Terraform, validates with our CI, and shows how to register it in the marketplace. Can we scope to a 30min lab?

sam_eng: yes. propose a minimal module: module/runtime -> deploys a small VM + storage with kms + security group. keep outputs small: endpoint + health URL. demo smoke test will curl health endpoint after apply.

rachel_infra: i'll take CI + validation. plan: GH Action that runs terraform fmt -> terragrunt? no, terraform init/plan -> terrascan -> optional smoke (on sandbox creds). we'll avoid applies in public CI.

lee_docs: i'll make the README: quickstart, prereqs, variables.example, submit-to-marketplace steps. add a short "what fails most often" list.

partner_incognito: ask: can the module be paramaterized to slot into our VPC? we need clear variable mapping (vpc_id, subnet_ids, iam role).

sam_eng: yes, module should accept network inputs; provide a default workflow that creates an ephemeral vpc for the lab. include example that wires to partner VPC using inputs.

rachel_infra: CI snippet for the slides:
```yaml
name: validate-module
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Terraform
        run: terraform --version || true
      - name: Terrascan
        run: terrascan scan -d . -p policies/
      - name: Terraform Init & Plan
        run: terraform init -input=false && terraform plan -input=false
```

build-bot: Workflow created: partners/validate-module (automated).

lee_docs: i'll also add a short appendix: "signing & provenance" referencing the sigstore example. not required for the lab but mention it for compliance teams.

joria_partners: timeline: workshop Thur 11am PT. deliverables by Wed EOD: repo skeleton under redwood-partners/marketplace-quickstart, sample module, CI workflow, README. RSVP list will be distributed tomorrow.

sam_eng: i'll create module template and a tiny example test (terraform apply -> local smoke script) in demo branch. dylan? (typo: meant rachel) please add terrascan baseline rules.

rachel_infra: will add baseline rules: deny ingress 0.0.0.0/0, require kms-enabled storage, require tags. will also add a troubleshooting checklist for provider version mismatches.

partner_incognito: thanks, that'll help our onboarding. we'll RSVP. prefer the lab to include a short Q&A slot for mapping module variables to partner roles.

joria_partners: noted. final note: keep hardware-specific tuning out of the core quickstart; append as "performance tuning" doc if partners ask. reconvene Wed 9am to confirm assets. :thumbsup:
